blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Streaming video understanding requires models to interpret an evolving visual world and interact while observations are still arriving [ 4 , 19 , 32 ] .
Unlike offline video understanding [ 34 ] , where the complete video is available before answering, streaming interaction unfolds through repeated decisions under partial observations.
At each turn, a model must decide whether to respond or continue observing [ 24 , 26 ] .
A useful assistant should respond when new evidence warrants an answer, provide follow-up information when needed, and remain silent when another reply would add little value.
The appropriate action therefore depends not only on the current visual evidence [ 7 , 11 , 30 ] , but also on what the model has already communicated.
Learning this sequence of response and waiting decisions requires feedback that reflects answer quality and interaction timing.
blocks.zh:
流相视频理解需要模型来解释一个正在演变的视觉世界,并在观测还在到来时进行互动[4,19,32].
与离线视频理解 [34] 不同的是,完整视频在回答之前是可用的,流出互动在部分观察下通过反复决定来展开.
在每一转弯,一个模型必须决定是响应还是继续观察[24,26].
在新的证据需要答复时,一名有用的助理应作出答复,在需要时提供后续信息,在另一答复无多大价值时保持沉默。
因此,适当的行动不仅取决于目前的视觉证据[7,11,30],还取决于模型已经传达的内容.
学习这种响应顺序和等待决定需要反馈,反映回答质量和交互时间.

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning [ 22 , 20 , 21 , 8 ] provides a natural way to learn these decisions from interaction-level feedback, with recent approaches adopting Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 21 ] .
MMDuet2 [ 26 ] optimizes proactive interaction with PAUC-based rewards [ 25 ] , while ThinkStream [ 16 ] combines incremental reasoning with rewards for correctness, format, and response timing.
StreamPro [ 13 ] further incorporates both turn-level and trajectory-level rewards to assess individual responses and overall interaction quality.
Reward design and short-span training [ 26 ] improve interaction feedback, but the trajectory-level GRPO formulations considered here still broadcast one advantage across decision turns.
Turn-level scoring and turn-specific policy credit are therefore distinct design choices.
blocks.zh:
加强学习[22、20、21、8]提供了从互动层面的反馈中学习这些决定的自然途径,最近的做法采用了集团相对政策优化[21]。
MMDuet2 [26] 优化了与基于PAUC的奖励的主动互动 [25] ;而ThinkStream [16] 结合了递增推理与对正确性,格式,回应时间的奖励.
StreamPro [13] 进一步纳入了回合级和轨迹级奖励,以评估个人反应和整体互动质量。
奖励设计和短期培训[26]改善互动反馈,但此处考虑的轨迹级GRPO配方仍然在决定转弯之间传播一种优势。
因此,回合级评分和回合特定政策信用是不同的设计选择。

blocks.en:
A good trajectory can contain bad turns, and a bad trajectory can contain good turns.
After a successful early response, a redundant reply may still inherit a positive trajectory advantage, even if the reward penalizes repetition ( Fig. 1 ).
Conversely, a useful follow-up after earlier failures may receive a negative advantage because the trajectory remains below the group average.
In both cases, rewards accrued before the current decision influence its learning signal, potentially obscuring the value of responding or waiting at that turn.
We therefore argue that a streaming decision’s learning signal should emphasize the return from that turn onward, rather than rewards accumulated earlier.
blocks.zh:
良好的轨迹可以包含坏转子,而糟糕的轨迹可以包含好转子.
在早期反应成功后,冗余的答复仍然可能继承积极的轨迹优势,即使奖励惩罚重复(图1)。
相反地,在先前失败之后采取有益的后续行动可能获得负面优势,因为轨迹仍然低于组平均数。
在这两种情况下,在目前决定之前累积的奖励会影响其学习信号,从而可能掩盖在这种转变时作出反应或等待的价值。
因此,我们主张,一个不断变化的决定的学习信号应该强调从这一转折中产生的回报,而不是先前积累的回报。

blocks.en:
Guided by this principle, we propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns advantage estimation and loss aggregation with streaming decisions.
Building on the return-to-go principle [ 22 ] , TurnWise exploits the explicit waiting action to score each trajectory prefix with all remaining turns set to silence.
Subtracting this prefix reference from the full trajectory reward yields a remaining return, from which we construct group-relative, turn-specific advantages.
Silence-completed prefix scoring converts trajectory feedback into turn-specific remaining-return advantages.
The computation reuses existing rollout evaluations, requiring neither a learned critic nor additional rollouts.
blocks.zh:
在这一原则的指导下,我们提议采用TurnWise这一转弯级GRPO框架,将优势估计和损失汇总与流化决定相协调。
TurnWise在回归原则[22]的基础上,利用明确的等待动作来分分每个轨迹前缀,所有剩余的转折被设定为静态.
从整个轨迹奖励中减去这个前缀的参考,会产生剩余的回报,我们从中构思出与集团相对的转折特定的优势.
静态完成的前缀评分将轨迹反馈转换为转向特定的剩余返回优势.
计算重新利用现有的推出评价,既不需要有学识的批评者,也不需要更多的推出。

blocks.en:
TurnWise couples turn-specific credit with equal weighting of response and waiting decisions.
Under token-mean aggregation, longer responses still receive larger aggregation weights than short waiting actions.
We therefore introduce turn-mean loss aggregation, averaging token losses within each turn before averaging across turns within each trajectory.
Turn-mean aggregation balances sampled response and waiting decisions directly in the RL objective, making each turn’s weight independent of its output length.
Together, the two designs make the decision turn a common unit for advantage estimation and loss aggregation, addressing both how a turn receives credit and how its feedback is weighted during policy optimization.
blocks.zh:
TurnWise夫妇转而提供具体的信贷,对反应和等待决定给予同等的分量。
在象征性汇总下,较长的回复仍比较短的等待行动获得更大的汇总权重。
因此,我们采用转动因子损失汇总法,在每个转动中,平均值损失,然后在每个转动轨道中平均值。
Turn-mean汇总在RL目标中直接进行抽样反应和等待决定,使每个转弯的权重独立于其输出长度.
这两个设计共同使决定成为进行优势估计和损失汇总的一个共同单位,既涉及一个回合如何获得信用,又涉及其反馈如何在政策优化期间加权。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We identify a granularity mismatch in streaming video RL. Shared trajectory advantages can obscure the value of later decisions, while token-mean loss aggregation makes turn weights depend on response length. • We introduce TurnWise, combining silence-completed prefix scoring for turn-specific remaining-return advantages with turn-mean loss aggregation, without a learned critic or additional rollouts. • We achieve the best aggregate scores on ProactiveVQA [ 25 ] , OVO-Timing [ 17 ] , and StreamingBench [ 15 ] with both Qwen backbones, and show that turn-mean aggregation improves response timing while reducing repetition relative to credit-only optimization.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 我们发现流视频RL中的颗粒性不匹配. 共享的轨迹优势可能掩盖后期决定的价值,而象征-平均损失汇总则使转动权重取决于反应长度。 我们引入了TurnWise,将静态完成的前缀评分与转动的剩余返回优势和转动的增减汇总相结合,没有学习的批评者或额外的推出. 我们在"主动VQA"[25],"OVO-Timing"[17],"流出奔驰"[15]两个主干上都取得了最佳的汇总分数,并显示"转正汇总"改善了响应时间,同时相对信用最优化减少了重复.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Streaming Video Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频流动

blocks.en:
Streaming video interaction extends offline video understanding [ 34 ] by requiring models to process incoming observations and decide when to communicate.
Unlike answering after viewing an entire video, these models must operate on observed prefixes and accommodate evolving user queries.
VideoLLM-online [ 4 ] introduces online video-language modeling, while MMDuet [ 24 ] broadens time-sensitive comprehension through interleaved video-text dialogue.
Dispider [ 19 ] disentangles perception, decision, and reaction, and StreamBridge [ 23 ] equips offline models with a lightweight proactive activation module.
TimeChat-Online [ 28 ] reduces visual redundancy, while Flash-VStream [ 33 ] maintains compact memory for real-time understanding of long video streams.
Streamo [ 27 ] further supports diverse streaming tasks through large-scale instruction tuning, including narration, event captioning, and time-sensitive question answering.
Benchmarks including ProactiveVideoQA [ 25 ] , OVO-Bench [ 17 ] , and StreamingBench [ 15 ] cover real-time perception, historical understanding, and proactive response timing.
These studies establish the setting for learning response and waiting decisions, while our work focuses on how RL feedback is assigned and weighted across those decisions.
blocks.zh:
流媒体视频互动通过要求模型处理所传入的观察,决定何时沟通,从而扩展了线下视频理解[34].
与观看了整个视频后回答不同,这些模型必须在被观察到的前缀上操作,并适应不断发展的用户查询.
VideoLLM-online [4]引入了在线视频语言建模,而MMDuet [24]通过互放视频-文本对话来拓宽时间感知.
Dispider [19] 分解感知,决定和反应,而StreamBridge [23] 为离线模型配备了轻量级主动活化模块.
TimeChat-Online [28] 减少视觉冗余,而Flash-VStream [33] 为实时理解长视频流而维持紧凑内存.
Streamo [27] 进一步支持通过大范围指令调制,包括解说,事件标题和时间敏感问答等多种流线任务.
基准包括 " 积极VideoQA[25] " 、 " OVO-Bench[17] " 和 " Streaming Bench[15] " ,涵盖实时感知、历史理解和积极主动的反应时间。
这些研究为学习反应和等待决定确立了环境,而我们的工作则侧重于如何分配和权衡RL反馈。

blocks.en: 2.2 Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.2 加强视频理解学习

blocks.en:
PPO [ 20 ] and GRPO [ 21 ] provide widely used foundations for language-model policy optimization.
Their application to video models has progressed from preference alignment to temporal reasoning and long-video training.
VLM-RLAIF [ 1 ] uses AI-generated feedback for video instruction tuning.
Video-R1 [ 9 ] encourages temporal reasoning through T-GRPO, VideoChat-R1 [ 14 ] strengthens spatio-temporal perception through reinforcement fine-tuning, and LongVILA-R1 [ 6 ] scales RL training to long video inputs.
Policy distillation can improve initialization for subsequent RL [ 8 , 29 ] .
In streaming settings, MMDuet2 [ 26 ] optimizes PAUC-based interaction rewards and uses short-span training to mitigate reward sparsity and temporal credit assignment.
ThinkStream [ 16 ] trains incremental reasoning with accuracy, format, and timing rewards, while StreamPro [ 13 ] combines turn-level response scores with trajectory-level coherence rewards.
These approaches improve evaluation of sampled interactions, but their trajectory-level GRPO formulations derive a shared advantage from the aggregated reward.
TurnWise aligns streaming policy optimization with decision turns through group-relative remaining-return credit and turn-mean loss aggregation.
blocks.zh:
PPO [20]和GRPO [21]为语言模型政策优化提供了被广泛使用的基础.
它们对视频模型的应用已从偏好调整到时间推理和长视频培训.
VLM-RLAIF [1] 使用AI生成的反馈进行视频指令调音.
Video-R1 [9] 鼓励通过T-GRPO,VideoChat-R1 [14] 通过强化微调增强时空感知,而LongVILA-R1 [6] 尺度 RL 培训用于长视频输入.
政策分馏可以改进初始化,用于以后的RL [8, 29].
在溪流设置中,MMDuet2[26]优化了基于PAUC的互动奖励,并使用短平分训练来减轻奖励的垃圾和时间信用分配.
ThinkStream [16] 以准确性,格式,以及时间奖励来训练递增推理,而StreamPro [13] 结合了回合级响应分数和轨迹级一致性奖励.
这些办法改进了对抽样互动的评价,但其轨迹一级的GRPO公式从汇总奖励中获得共同优势。
TurnWise将流转政策优化与决策相协调,转而通过集团关系剩余收益信贷和转正亏损汇总.

blocks.en: 4.1 Training Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训管道

blocks.en:
We first fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 3 ] and Qwen3-VL-4B [ 2 ] on EgoExo4D [ 10 ] , EgoExoLearn [ 12 ] , Live-WhisperX [ 5 ] , Tarsier2 [ 31 ] , and LLaVA-Video [ 34 ] .
Both models use the same SFT corpus of 100,874 valid instruction examples, with 1 % 1\% held out for validation.
SFT runs for one epoch at learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} with the vision tower frozen.
We then optimize the streaming policies with GRPO-style reinforcement learning [ 21 ] , using groups of sampled trajectories to form relative advantage signals.
RL uses 3,983 streaming instances with 20-second target segments, initial dialogue context, and at most 90 frames sampled every two seconds, following MMDuet2 [ 26 ] .
We use the PAUC-based reward in equation 1 , judged by gpt-oss-20b [ 18 ] .

两种型号都使用100,874个有效指令示例的同一种SFT套件,1%的1\%被扣去验证.
SFT以10 -5 10 -5的学习速度运行了一个时代,视觉塔被冻结了.
然后用GRPO风格的强化学习来优化流线政策[21],利用被采样的轨迹组形成相对优势信号.
RL使用有20秒目标段的3,983个流出例,初始对话上下文,最多每2秒抽取90个帧,紧接MMDuet2 [26].
我们使用基于PAUC的奖励 在方程式1, 判断gpt-oss-20b [18]。

blocks.en:
All RL configurations use batch size 8 and G = 4 G=4 rollouts per instance, with temperature 1.2 and top- k = 10 k=10 , following MMDuet2 [ 26 ] .
We train for one epoch with AdamW at learning rate 10 − 6 10^{-6} , one policy optimization epoch per batch, and no KL or entropy regularization.
TurnWise freezes the vision tower and uses turn-mean aggregation, with α \alpha linearly warmed up to 1 over the first 10 % 10\% of scheduled updates.

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准

blocks.en:
We evaluate on ProactiveVQA [ 25 ] , using 300 instances across Ego, TV, VAD, and Web to assess answer quality and timeliness within reply windows.
OVO-Timing [ 17 ] evaluates event-triggered responses on CRR, SSR, and REC.
StreamingBench [ 15 ] tests answer correctness from observed video prefixes through Real-Time Visual Understanding, and joint answer correctness and timing through Proactive Output.
Together, these benchmarks assess complementary aspects of streaming policies: proactive answer quality, event-triggered timing, and real-time visual understanding.
blocks.zh:
我们评价主动VQA[25],
OVO-Timing [17] 评估事件引发的关于CRR、SSR和REC的反应。
流出 Bench [15] 测试通过实时视觉理解解答所观察到的视频前缀的正确性,通过主动输出解答联合答案的正确性和时间.
这些基准共同评估了流动政策的互补方面:主动回答质量、事件触发时间和实时视觉理解。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluations
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价

blocks.en:
We compare TurnWise with SFT models and the RL baselines MMDuet2, ThinkStream [ 16 ] , and StreamPro [ 13 ] , implemented in the same streaming GRPO framework.
All models use greedy decoding with observed video prefixes and their own previous responses as context.
blocks.zh:
我们比较TurnWise与SFT模型和RL基线MMDuet2, ThinkStream [16],以及StreamPro [13],它们在同一流流式GRPO框架中执行.
所有模型都使用有可观察到的视频前缀的贪婪解码以及自己的先前的回音作为上下文.

blocks.en:
On ProactiveVQA, we report PAUC with ω = 0.5 \omega=0.5 , judged by GPT-5.6-luna and averaged equally across four categories; ablations also report repetition rates among non-silent replies.
OVO-Timing uses Timing F1 with one-to-one matching within ± 2 \pm 2 seconds.
We compute F1 from mean per-instance precision and recall for each task, then average equally across CRR, SSR, and REC.
For StreamingBench, we report multiple-choice accuracy on Real-Time Visual Understanding and joint answer-and-timing accuracy within ± 2 \pm 2 seconds on Proactive Output, and their equal-weight mean.

关于积极主动的VQA,我们报告PAUC = 0.5\omega = 0.5, 由GPT-5.6-luna 判断,平均分为四类;同时报告非静态答复的重复率。
OVO-Timing在±2\pm2秒内使用一对一匹配的Timing F1.
我们从每次任务的平均精确度和召回率计算出F1,然后在中央资源评估、安全部门改革和区域经济共同体中平均。
对于"流出奔驰",我们报告实时视觉理解的多选择精度,以及"主动输出"的±2\pm2秒内的联合回答和计时精度,以及它们的等重平均值.

blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares TurnWise with SFT and GRPO-based RL baselines on three streaming benchmarks.
TurnWise achieves the best aggregate scores on three benchmarks with both backbones.
On Qwen2.5-VL-3B, it reaches 43.56 PAUC on ProactiveVQA, 21.59 average Timing F1 on OVO-Timing, and 49.43 average accuracy on StreamingBench, exceeding the strongest non-TurnWise results by 3.96, 3.87, and 0.69 points, respectively.
On Qwen3-VL-4B, the scores are 42.44, 11.15, and 58.96, with gains of 6.26, 1.92, and 2.38 points.
blocks.zh:
表1将TurnWise与基于SFT和基于GRPO的RL基线在三个流线基准上进行比较.
TurnWise在两个主干线的三个基准上都取得了最好的总分.
在Quen2.5-VL-3B上,它分别达到43.56 PAUC在"主动VQA"上,21.59平均Timing F1在OVO-Timing上,49.43平均精度在"流出奔驰"上,分别超过最强的非TurnWise结果3.96分,3.87分和0.69分.
在Quen3-VL-4B上,得分分别为42.44分,11.15分和58.96分,得分分别为6.26分,1.92分和2.38分.

blocks.en:
The improvements extend across both proactive interaction and visual understanding.
On ProactiveVQA, TurnWise leads all four categories with the 3B backbone and three of four with the 4B backbone.
For the latter, VAD and Web improve by 3.49 and 6.43 points over the strongest competing results.
On StreamingBench, TurnWise obtains the highest real-time and proactive accuracies with both backbones.
In particular, the 4B model reaches 38.40 proactive accuracy, compared with 35.60 for the strongest baseline, while also improving real-time accuracy from 78.24 to 79.52.
Across both backbones, TurnWise improves proactive interaction, response timing, and real-time visual understanding.
blocks.zh:
这些改进包括主动互动和视觉理解。
在"主动VQA"上,TurnWise以3B主干领导所有4个类别,以4B主干领导3个.
就后者而言,VAD和Web比最强的竞争结果提高3.49分和6.43分。
在"流出奔驰"上,"TurnWise"以两种骨干获得最高的实时和主动快感.
特别是,4B型机车达到了38.40主动精度,而最强基线为35.60,同时将实时精度从78.24提高到79.52.
TurnWise在两个骨干上都改进了主动互动、反应时间和实时视觉理解。

blocks.en:
On Qwen2.5-VL-3B, combining turn-level credit with turn-mean aggregation reduces repetition by 61.5 % 61.5\% relative to credit-only optimization, from 15.53 to 5.98, while increasing Timing F1 by 2.96 points and StreamingBench average accuracy by 0.49 points ( Table 2 ).
Turn-level credit determines each decision’s learning direction; turn-mean aggregation determines its weight in the policy update.
Their combination achieves the highest aggregate task scores among the evaluated component configurations.
Relative to turn-mean aggregation alone, combining both components improves Timing F1 by 13.42 points and reduces repetition by 38.9 % 38.9\% .
blocks.zh:
在Quen2.5-VL-3B上,将转会级信用与转会-转会-转会-转会汇总相结合,将重复率从15.53分降至5.98分,减少61.5%-61.5分,同时将计时F1增加2.96分,将Bench平均精度提高0.49分(表2).
回合级信用决定每个决定的学习方向;回合-平均值汇总决定其在政策更新中的权重.
它们的组合在被评价的组件配置中实现了最高的总任务分.
与转正聚合相对,结合两个组件将Timing F1提高13.42分并减少38.9%38.9\%.

blocks.en:
Within the complete TurnWise framework on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, full correction ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ) achieves the highest PAUC, Timing F1, and StreamingBench accuracy and the lowest repetition among the tested correction strengths ( Table 3 ).
This identifies full accrued-reward correction as the operating point for TurnWise.
blocks.zh:
在Wen2.5-VL-3B的完整TurnWise框架内,完全校正(α = 1\alpha = 1)达到PAUC最高分,Timing F1,并流出奔驰精度和被测试校正强度中重复次数最少(表3).
这确定了TurnWise的操作点是全额应计报酬更正。

blocks.en: 5.2 Training Dynamics and Response Behavior
blocks.zh: 5.2 培训动态和反应行为

blocks.en:
Turn-mean aggregation raises mean reward from 0.657 to 0.711 over the final 50 updates while reducing repetition-penalty magnitude from 0.069 to 0.036 ( Fig. 3 , panels a and b).
Both configurations use the same turn-level credit rule and Qwen2.5-VL-3B SFT initialization across 497 updates.
The outside-window reply fraction decreases from 0.537 to 0.289, while the non-silent decision fraction falls from 62.2 % 62.2\% to 37.0 % 37.0\% (panel c).
Higher reward accompanies more selective response behavior under turn-mean aggregation.

在最后50项更新中,转正汇总将平均奖励从0.657提高到0.711,同时将重复处罚的幅度从0.069降至0.036(图3,a和b面板)。
两种配置都采用了相同的转会级信用规则和Qun2.5-VL-3B SFT在497个更新中初始化.
外部窗口回复分数从0.537降至0.289,而非静态决定分数从62.2 % 62.2\%降至37.0% 37.0\%(c小堂)。
更高的奖励在转动-平均值聚合下伴有更多的选择性反应行为.

blocks.en: 5.3 Credit Redistribution on Real Training Trajectories
blocks.zh: 5.3 真实培训轨迹的再分配

blocks.en:
Turn-level credit assigns negative advantages to 59.83 % 59.83\% of the repetitive replies that receive positive global advantages—432 of 722 replies in the analyzed cohort. Fig. 4 compares the logged turn advantages with the global advantages computed from the same sampled groups and terminal rewards.
The analysis covers 11,116 complete Qwen2.5-VL-3B training trajectories with full credit correction at α = 1 \alpha=1 , comprising 84,184 decision turns.
As shown in panel a of Fig. 4 , 21.20 % 21.20\% of decisions change advantage sign relative to global allocation, and 53.15 % 53.15\% of trajectories receive both positive and negative turn advantages.
Thus, a single trajectory provides distinct learning directions for its constituent decisions.

转折信贷给得到全球正面好处的重复答复59.83%59.83%的负面好处——在被分析的组群中,722份答复中有432份是负面的。 图4比较了记录的转弯优势和从同一抽样组和终端奖励中计算出来的全球优势。

如图4的A面板所示,21.20%的决定与全球分配相比改变优势标志,53.15%的轨迹获得正向和负向优势。

This differentiation also targets redundant replies within positively ranked trajectories.
Panel b of Fig. 4 shows that turn-level credit increases the share receiving negative advantages from 75.7 % 75.7\% to 81.6 % 81.6\% across all 2,972 Judge-labeled repetitive replies in this cohort.
These recorded advantages show that turn-level credit assigns distinct learning directions within a trajectory and provides suppressive signals for redundant replies in positively ranked trajectories.
blocks.zh:
这种区分还针对正排名轨迹中的多余答复。
图4的b小组显示,在这一组中,在2 972份法官重复答复中,回合级信贷获得的负面好处份额从75.7%75.7%增加到81.6%81.6%。

blocks.en: 5.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.4 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Tables 2 , 3 , 3 and 4 highlight complementary roles for credit assignment and loss aggregation: the former determines each turn’s learning signal, while the latter controls its optimization weight.
Remaining-return advantages improve credit assignment, while turn-mean aggregation balances response and waiting decisions.
Their combination improves task scores and Timing F1 while reducing redundant and outside-window replies.
TurnWise unifies credit assignment and policy optimization at the decision-turn level.
A deterministic scan of cached PAUC assessments computes the prefix references without additional rollouts or judge calls.
Across the evaluated settings, this alignment improves task performance and response timing while reducing redundant replies.
blocks.zh:
表2、表3、表3和表4突出了信贷分配和损失汇总的互补作用:前者决定每个转弯的学习信号,而后者控制其优化权重。
剩余收益优势改善了信贷分配,同时转正汇总余额反应和等待决定。
他们的组合提高了任务分数和Timing F1,同时减少了冗余和外窗的答复.
TurnWise统一了信用分配和在决策回合一级的政策优化。
对缓存的PAUC评估进行确定性扫描,计算前缀参考文献,不另推出或裁判电话.
在整个被评价的环境下,这种调整可以改善任务业绩和反应时间,同时减少重复答复。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
TurnWise makes the decision turn the common unit of credit assignment and policy optimization in streaming video RL.
Silence-completed prefix references remove previously accrued rewards from later-turn credit, while turn-mean aggregation gives response and waiting decisions equal weight, without a learned critic or additional rollouts.
Across two Qwen backbones, TurnWise achieves the best aggregate results on all three evaluated benchmarks, with component analyses supporting higher-quality, better-timed, and more selective responses .
blocks.zh:
TurnWise让决定转出流视频RL中常见的信用分配和政策优化单位.
静态完成的前缀引用从后转的信用中删除了先前累积的奖励,而转正汇总给出的回应和等待决定的权重相等,没有学习的批评者或额外的推出.
TurnWise在两个Quen主干线上,在所有三个评价基准上都取得了最佳的总结果,组成部分分析支持质量更高、更及时和更有选择性的反应。
